related with the study of nuclear transition dynamics. We analyse the efficiency of excitation of the isomeric nuclear state <jats:sup>229m<\/jats:sup>Th by the fifth harmonic of Ti: Sa laser generated in thorium by two-color femtosecond pulse consisting of the fundamental and thensecond harmonic of Ti: Sa laser (\u03c9+2\u03c9). It is shown that the rate of isomeric state excitation can be enhanced significantly with respect to other nucleus excitation processes in laser plasma or by an external coherent source at the resonance wavelength.
